items.title: Spiral Galaxy NGC 1300
items.description: Hubble captures a barred spiral galaxy 61 million light-years away in the constellation Eridanus.

items.title: Andromeda Galaxy Wide Field
items.description: A sweeping view of the Andromeda Galaxy, the nearest major galaxy to the Milky Way.

items.title: Whirlpool Galaxy M51
items.description: The graceful winding arms of the grand-design spiral galaxy M51 appear like a perfect cosmic whirlpool.

items.title: Sombrero Galaxy M104
items.description: One of the most photogenic galaxies, the Sombrero features a brilliant white core encircled by thick dust lanes.
